text: TASK: create or revise slice {{slice_id}} ({{slice_title}}) against its current reviewed literary work note.

items.text: Did the delivered text invent facts, lore, diction, motifs, characters, scenes, or editorial machinery instead of reusing what the manuscript already establishes? Answer with the passages you checked and any case found.

Does the revision match the declared audience, genre, form, and editorial stage while preserving deliberate voice, ambiguity, rhythm, and unconventional form? Answer with the standard used and any excess found.

Put the delivered change next to the brief: is it the smallest coherent intervention that achieves the intended reader effect, with no unrelated polish or exhaustive lens audit? Answer with a brief comparison.
